notes.title: Familia 1.3.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i][h3]Thank you for your continued support. Life has been crazy, but I still managed to get a meaningful patch out. Please comment and like this post. :D[/h3]
[/i]
[h2]Platforms[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game was released on Android: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=maui.familia.game&pli=1]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=maui.familia.game&pli=1[/url]

[*] Updated Mac and Windows versions of the game
[*] Familia Act 1 is now free
[/list]
[h2]Menus[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated: Load / Save Menu
[*] Updated: Community Menu
[*] A fullscreen setting has been added to the game’s options for desktop (for Steamdeck)
[*] FPS option added to the options menu
[*] All sub-menus have a different background
[/list]
[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] All UI is now compatible with the Touchscreen, Gamepad, and Keyboard
[*] Added: Swipe gestures for specific menus
[*] Onscreen joystick and buttons, visible when players are touching the screen and hidden otherwise
[*] Analog movement added, compatible with the gamepad and touchscreen

[olist]

[/olist]

[list]
[*] Updated tutorial intro battle
[*] Updated airship cutscene
[*] Updater Slitherdice cutscene

notes.title: Familia Act 1, 1.3 Release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4XhzWZ32AU0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Personal Message from the Developer[/h3]

Holy cow! My last major update on Steam was March 20th, 2021. To say it has been too long since I've posted an update is an understatement. I'll admit I got discouraged on this project and a bit burnt out. I took some time to recover and now I'm back in full swing. The last quarter of 2021 was extremely productive for the Familia franchise.

[h2]Familia Act 2 Revised Release Date[/h2]

[h3]Everyone always asks me when Familia, Act 2 will be released.[/h3]

I currently have the Act 2 release date set to this summer. This date will most likely be pushed back further. I keep going back and cleaning up / adding content to Act 1. This means that Act 1 is better, which creates a better foundation for Act 2, so ultimately it's what is best for the whole series. Please be patient. If you would like to expediate the release of additional Familia content, please consider leaving a review or gifting the game to your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1197520/Familia/
Make sure to Wishlist Act 2. It really helps to keep the project on track.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474730/Familia_Act_2/

[h1]Familia Act 1, 1.3: New Features[/h1]

[h3]Introducing the Reach Facility[/h3]

Many hardcore Familia players have requested more difficult and scalable content. Your voices have been heard. Familia 1.3 introduces the Reach Facility.

[i]In ancient times, the mysterious Immortals used the Reach Facility to train their bodies and minds to endure unimaginable horrors. The facility has gone unused for millennia until now. With the help of eletrowisps Oxalis 883 and Scilla 691, you can explore the perilous Reaches. Reaches are dimensional gaps in reality, which are disjointed from spacetime. Here our heroes will face adversaries who are unimaginably powerful.[/i]

[previewyoutube=5NdOIXTRzqk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Random / Scalable Dungeons and Loot[/h3]

The Reach Facility, features access to Familia's new procedural dungeon generation system. Every visit to the Reaches will be unique. All runs can also be set to a difficulty level from 1 to 9999 with Oxalis 883.  The Reach Facility also gives the player access to the most powerful armor and weapons in the game. Loot from the Reaches is procedurally generated.

[h3]New Post Max Level Progression System[/h3]

Now when your characters hit level 50, they will become a Master of their class. At this point, they can level up their 'master level'. Each master level allows you to upgrade a specific stat of your choice by a limited amount. The stat allocation can currently only be managed by  Oxalis 883 .

[h2]Additional Questlines[/h2]

Gain access to the Reach Facility by completing new questlines. The new questlines update the player on Familia's favorite Goblin, Glen. Glen must be found to help open a mysterious ancient door located in the Kalbi Waterways.

[h2]Updated Sprite Art, Maps[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/0903f882541a00851b1ac74a63d6b13dcee4fe72.jpg[/img]

I moved away from the RPG Maker sprite style. I also have set up a system to scale sprites which gives more variety to the game. As I've become more skilled in game dev and art creation, I've implemented more stunning visual content. 

There are a few maps I intend to upgrade but for the most part, all of the maps have had a very customized touch.

[h3]New Cut Scenes[/h3]

Along with new maps and sprites, many cutscenes have been refined and enhanced.
[previewyoutube=uECWmItuZzs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

There were many bugs plaguing the game for far too long. I'm happy to say that the game is currently boasting very little bugs thanks to all of the community playtesting. I could not do it without you guys. If you find a bug, PLEASE REPORT IT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/6c23c665039b375899c488a358a3fac726b2afa6.png[/img]

[h3]Android Act 1 Beta and Act 2 Desktop Beta[/h3]

Beta versions of both mobile and desktop port of Familia will be hosted on itch.io. Here you can test unreleased content and help contribute to the development process.

[url=https://mauigamestudio.itch.io/familia][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/10b5247485d6c7d3b1f2309a4cca88dcc1757e57.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Coming Soon: Features and Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Additional scalable content
[*] Additional map remakes and enhancements
[*] An estimated 30 new steam achievements to go with new content
[/list]

[h2]Familia Act II Release Date[/h2]

The official release date for Familia Act II is June 9th. The Steam page for Familia Act II is up and running.[b] Help speed up the games release by wish-listing now.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1474730/Familia_Act_2/

Right now if you visit the page, there is a page of me talking about the game. It's not a very polished trailer. Expect some awesome trailers soon. 

[h2]Familia Act I, 1.2[/h2]

[h3]New running character sprites for all humanoid characters in the [b]entire game[/b][/h3]
Yes, I will be and have been creating new sprites for weeks to come. The run-of-the-mill RPG Maker style sprites are not in alignment with the rest of the game's high quality and original style. notes.title: Familia Available for Mac OS
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=BK-p7oc6pIQ;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]Edit: [i]It has come to my attention that with the most recent update, people are losing their saves. Don't worry! The saves are safe in your installed Familia folder. In the Familia install directory, simply grab the files in the 'www/save' folder and move them to the 'save' folder at the top of the Familia directory. If there is no 'save' folder in the Familia directory, simply create one. Doing the above should restore any lost saves. Let me know if you have any additional questions.
[/i]
[h1]Mac Port Available[/h1]

Familia, Act 1 is now available for Mac OS. Setting up a Mac OS port was difficult, so please give it a try. There are probably still a couple of Mac OS specific bugs so make sure to report those to me. Just like the Windows version, the Mac OS version of Familia requires a Steam client.

[h1]Migrated RPG to Maker MZ Engine[/h1]
[h2]For Developers[/h2]
For those of you who are curious about the development side of things, I am now using RPG Maker MZ to continue to work on Familia. I tried RPG Maker MZ when it was first released and was not impressed. However, at second glance, migrating my game to RPG Maker MZ was relatively painless. I initially thought a migration would be far more difficult. 
[h2]For Everyone[/h2]
For those of you who just want to play the game, with RPG Maker MZ Familia runs faster than ever. So if you have an older computer, the new version of Familia will run smoother than before. Also, I am always getting better at game development so as I work on the game, it organically becomes exponentially optimized.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
The structure of Familia utilizes Acts that are broken into parts. Since the original release of the game, Act 1 featured five parts. With this release, I have added the sixth and final part of Act 1. Act 1, Part Six will be essential in setting up Act 2. Eventually, Act 2, 3, 4, and 5 will be playable in the player's desired order. Thus Act 1, Part 6 will assume the role of a major quest hub where players will choose which character story they wish to follow first.

[h2]Future Content[/h2]
Familia Act 2 will most likely be released as a DLC. I will be working regularly on Familia content, but I have also been flirting with a retro-style MMO action RPG. The working title for my MMO is 'Stormers' and I have been building it in Unity engine. Expect a new Steam page for both Familia Act 2 and Stormers by the end of the year.

[h2]General Changes[/h2][list]
[*] New Sprite for Shifu
[*] New title screen changed to work with RPG Maker MZ
[*] Each part of every act gives the player a save option (thx KinikzulKahn)
[*] Greater flexibility in sound levels in the options menu (thx Kevin Tracy)
[*] Fire Fiend no longer has a video background due to RPG Maker MZ incompatibility
[*] Updated logo to represent Maui Game Studio rebrand
[/list]

[h2]Small Bugs[/h2][list]
[*] In the deserted island world map, enemies are less difficult
[*] Grammar and spelling fixes
[*] Cleaned up Sarai / Saraiah's death animation
[*] Fixed Camera glitches in many scenes
[*] Fixed Keira intro scene
[*] Cleaned up multi-party fight sequence
[/list]

[h2]New Rebrand[/h2]
As a side note, I have rebranded my game development company. The new name is 'Maui Game Studio'. I took the opportunity to highlight come culturally Hawaiian symbols in the new logo. I hope you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/b5dd352ee57e4365ec7e5e4a8bf78073434bb83a.png[/img]

Edit: I made a video about switching engines on YouTube.

[previewyoutube=gdu-kZ5lU6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Random Encounter Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Random Encounters Removed form All Areas Except World Map[/h1]
[h3]These areas include the following:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Intro desert areas
[*]Kalbi Beach, Kalbi Waterfall, Kalbi Cave
[*]Volcano areas
[*]Kalbi Castle, Kalbi Dungeon, Kalbi Jail Caves
[*]Cave and path leading to Kalbian Refuge
[i]*The world map features random encounters in the same way it did before.[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Why did I make this change?[/h3]
The truth is that I've always been on the fence regarding random encounters. I was trying to create something like the games I played in the 90s. I have achieved that. However, after extensive research and testing I've come to the conclusion that the younger generation of gamers have no patience for random encounters. 

This was a difficult decision for me to make, as I love random encounters. I hope to have some form of random encounters as a gameplay option eventually but currently my resources only allow me to create and maintain one version of the game.

[h3]How do encounters work now?[/h3]
Now in hostile areas, enemies will walk around randomly as visible sprites. If your bump into an enemy sprite, they will attack you. Certain sprites will even chase you. 

[h2]Familia, Act 2 Updates[/h2]
[h3]A Warning to Data Miners[/h3]
Act 2 content can be found in Familia's current public build, even if not accessible through normal gameplay methods. While I prefer the game is not mined for spoilers I'm also aware that such things are inevitable. All mined content should be considered tentative.

[h3]Timeline for the Release of Act 2 and Other Future Acts[/h3]
I've had difficulty acquiring high-quality art. Fans of the Familia franchise have high standards for art quality. I am talking specifically about the art I used for character portraits. A continued episodic release is proving more difficult than I initially expected. Recommissioning the same artists multiple times is unrealistic. I will continue to build out the series with placeholder art, which will allow me to commission all the needed art in one go. Thus, the game will be completed later that I hoped. If you would like the game sooner, donations and purchases always help. I'm currently considering a membership program similar to Patreon.

[h3]Additional Ways to Play the New Familia Content Sooner[/h3]
I always welcome testers, especially Twitch streamers. I find streaming new game content to be the useful because I get to see multiple opinions in a single live interaction. Video content creators are great as well. Thus, if you are a content creator and would like to play early versions of the game please contact me. Testing is not exclusive to content creators. Anyone can help. If you are interested in testing Familia, join my discord server or drop by my stream to chat. 
Discord: https://discord.gg/V7TxkbF
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/josephdevelops

[h3]Other Miscellaneous Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Grammar and spelling corrections
[*]Fixed many glitches relating to looting chests animation
[/list]

notes.title: New Dungeon Live: Mother's Cave
notes.notes:
[h1]New Optional Dungeon Available[/h1]
[h2]Mother's Cave[/h2]

I am excited to announce the first optional dungeon for Familia Act 1 is live. This dungeon was a joy to create because I got to create a story within the Familia universe that wasn't confined to the progression of the main plotline. This dungeon is unlike any of the existing game.

[h2]New Dungeon Features:[/h2]

[h3]No Random Encounters[/h3]
While for the most part, Familia is a classic RPG so random encounters come with the territory. However, I wanted to create a dungeon with zero random encounters. Mother's Cave features zero random encounters.

[h3]New Art and Animation[/h3]
Again Animlouis has helped with some Animations. I am blown away that this guy is willing to help out the project. He is so gracious when I give him feedback. The new animations look great.

[h3]New Playable Sub-Class[/h3]
While the class is a bit simple, it will be a welcomed addition to Familia players. I can't describe the class too much because it's heavily related to the story of the Mother's Cave. Careful, the new class design may be permanent. 

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
Many new unique fights with new and unique abilities. Fight the most difficult enemies ever seen in the Familia world. New enemies also come with many new abilities.

[h3]New Achievement[/h3]
Complete Familia's most difficult achievement yet by surviving the perils of Mother's Cave.

[h2]Other General Updates to Familia[/h2]

[h3]Game+ Bosses Beefed Up[/h3]

The following Bosses Have Been Replaced by More Difficult Versions for Game+

[list]
[*] Glen > Glen+
[*] Slitherdice > Super Slitherdice
[*] Sarai > Saraiah
[*] Lyonhart > Coldhart
[*] Abrams > Abraham
[*] Noway > Noway of the Blood Sword
[/list]
[i]I currently am debating making a more difficult version of the 'Fiend of Fire' but have not worked out the details.[/i]

[h3]General Game Updates[/h3]

Duel Wield Improvements
The dual wield system in the game now damages separately for each hit. Previously, dual-wielding simply combined the traits of both weapons and ran them twice. Going forward, this will heavily affect many abilities. For example, some abilities will only consider the main hand with stacking damage. 

Also, certain weapons will only be equipable with two hands. The most prominent example would be the King's Odachi.

[h3]NPC named Emi will remove all party gear at the Kalbian refuge.[/h3]

The main characters' home now features an in-game tutorial that gives game mechanic insight in the game. Also, the same content from the in-game tutorial can be found in this guide: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2101704986]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2101704986[/url].

[h3]Small Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Options Menu Visuals Improved
[*] Fixed many skill animations to fit with newer rendering methods
[*] Sage Tunic, Kung Fu Hat, Shadow's Parts are now all sellable
[*] Many battle animations would make the character menu stop displaying, this has been fixed
[*] Ninjas using the King's Odachi will now display the correct animation
[/list]

[h2]Community Annoucements[/h2]

[h3]New Speed Run Page [/h3]
Thanks to Euphoric Lemon for creating a speed run page for Familia. Check it out.
[url=https://www.speedrun.com/familia]https://www.speedrun.com/familia[/url]

Follow Euphoric Lemon on Twitch.
https://www.twitch.tv/euphoriclemon

Join the Familia Discord for the Latest Info.
https://discord.gg/NADM8zM

notes.title: Act 1 Complete
notes.notes:
Thank you, everyone, for your help to make Familia the best game it can be. Not only have I received tons of feedback but many from the community have actually helped me with art and code for the game. @Animlouis and @Codemora, in particular, have been especially helpful for this last update.

This update post will be categorized into Art/Music, User Interface, Story, and Mechanics.


[h1]Art and Music[/h1]

[h2]All Enemies Animated[/h2]
With the help of Animlouis, we all have 100%, animated enemies. Initially, in order to keep the project in an achievable scope, I was trying to avoid animated enemies. However, after a massive backlash, I decided to take the time to minimally animate all of the enemies in the game.

[h2]Added Additional Music[/h2]
Some of the game scenes felt a bit too one-dimensional so a few additional songs were added for some tonal variety. 

[h2]Walking Sprites + Battler Sprites[/h2]
Additional sprites were required. Showing them here would be a bit of a spoiler but let me know if you see them in the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/adf8b69ae5aa60c4762301b81778717d9664f7c6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/c40c0dd7283e3d8797f712d9503914f4eef5cae7.png[/img][/url]


[h1]User Inteface[/h1]

[h2]New Community Menu[/h2]
After checking out a game called Insignia by Adam C. Yunis ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/adamcyounis]https://www.twitch.tv/adamcyounis[/url]), I decided to add a community menu. Now, players can access my Twitch, Instagram, Discord, and website from the game.

[h2]Victory and Level Up Scenes[/h2]
Thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/SuccubellaGames]Isabella Ava[/url] ([url=https://master2015hp.itch.io/olivia-victory-addon]https://master2015hp.itch.io/olivia-victory-addon[/url]) and [url=https://discord.gg/8wVaHRz]Olivia[/url] ([url=https://fallenangelolivia.itch.io/victory-sequence-ui]https://fallenangelolivia.itch.io/victory-sequence-ui[/url]) for creating great plugins. Also thanks to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/codemora]Codemora[/url] for helping me edit these plugins so they victory screen aligned with my vision. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/5a0beda5f684c6df634e4c3d8880e81b9b460285.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/0dfd1e7477a33f3eb596ba186ac690f51fe218f0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/839ff6e234a1d8a858ebab54d7fa28e1ad298f17.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/863acb8d55549233a39a732a865701d9182a971e.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Escape Tutorial[/h2]
If players were not accustomed to RPG's, they may not realize they can escape from battle. Now at the beginning of the player's first fight, a quick tutorial pops up and lets the player know that escaping is an option.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/e86b0c2b174670d57aa304fa58494fdabd443fb0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/850efa583510bac4b76f9c48f53c106f8bd4c0b6.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Different Prologue Scene[/h2]
The prologue has been edited to be a bit more interesting. Return players also will be able to skip the prologue for speed runs. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/258dbb502341c5367cc1d4a96fdb414394eabec0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/03090563c615045f702900f7c597d69a794bbe6f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/cf7d53dde8c7ca911b8cb1faddce7a7fb7e1ccf5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/d9bbc6e371d5d01ea2b1519326df87d897b3b16a.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Story[/h1]

[h2]Credits Scene[/h2]
New unique credit scenes, giving thanks to all those who helped Familia get to this point

[h2]Mid-game scene[/h2]
I don't want to go into depth about this scene. It contains massive spoilers. It was originally going to be a very long scene and it has been shortened, and I'm very happy with it.

[h2]New Main Town[/h2]
The main town always seemed a bit unfinished, so I went ahead and rebuilt the town from scratch. It has a much nicer vibe now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/7d29e9218bd1d149d186049eb98280fde4d95561.png[/img]


[h1]Mechanics[/h1]

[h2]Increased Elemental Significance[/h2]
Elemental damage and absorption were lacking consistency in the world of Azaconia. For the most part, this has been fixed. The elemental strengths and weaknesses in the game are largely influenced by ninjutsu in the Naruto universe.

[h2]Rebalanced battle[/h2]
Based on test feedback, the game has been made generally easier. Many people feel that the game is still a bit too difficult, but I am standing pretty firm on the current level of difficulty. Let me know what you think.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/630f41e3cc61f87c6bb370a674a0d5ff75c571b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/dfb126d9f9ab3ad27dd800db7489230e27f1cea9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/099034b6e796b1b6cee6e9b73ffc97aa2e8a355e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/9695238a1bfb02dfde6eaddcb28243e72570f922.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/7eb418e35a5da7e96e90339f2c488a5e715e9015.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/015353ef6214fd6e3f987be2d5924d78658fd87c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/493da4170abbc937861b06f41b151721974b3c98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/ecb47ed9f2a9f3f69d5f84e5b6ee5a7f3580a5c1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Additional Achievements[/h2]
Added additional achievements. The most difficult achievement was completed by @VetheGoth. This achievement requires the player to defeat a superboss with Sero at the party.

[h2]Added Many New Skills[/h2]
Both enemies and playable characters gained about 30 new skills in this last update.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed bug which made character uncontrollable after the glen fight
[*]Various dialogue has been added. Much more dialogue has been edited. Let me know if you find any grammar or spelling errors, please.
[*]Fixed bug where Sero is reverted to level 1 at a certain point of the game.
[*]Fixed various mode7 bugs.
[/list]

[h1]What is next for Familia? [/h1]
[h3]Any additional content for Act 1?[/h3]
Act 1 will include a few additional sidequests before Act 2 begins full-scale production. The sidequests will be quests that the player is able to complete at multiple points of the game for helpful gear. My plan is to spend roughly a month creating sidequest content, then I'll decide the exact amount of optional dungeons the game will include. I'm fairly confident that there will be two additional dungeons minimum.

[h3]What's next after Act 1?[/h3]
In the last update post, I was debating what next steps we will be taking. The two options (1) set up a demo for mobile ports or (2) start on Act 2. I've decided to start on Act 2 Next. The mobile port will not come along for a while. Windows-based computers easily run Familia with no additional processing optimization. It's best to have a clear view of the current state of current devices before starting a mobile port. If I began the port now, the porting process would have a much larger scope when compared to porting a complete game.

[h3]New Trailer Incoming[/h3]
A few trailers are on the way. I want to do three trailers. I plan to first release a gameplay trailer, with a voiceover from myself. Second, I want to do a story trailer, with maybe a guest voice actor. Then I want to release a streamer compilation showing different people enjoying the game.

notes.title: Long Anticipated Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Familia Community![/h1]

I am positively overwhelmed by the support from the Familia community. So many people are submitting bugs and helping me polish this game. It's truly a community project and words cannot express my gratitude. I am continually amazed by the amazing Familia family. I love you guys.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/cf7d53dde8c7ca911b8cb1faddce7a7fb7e1ccf5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/d9bbc6e371d5d01ea2b1519326df87d897b3b16a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/2670e3db9047ba8a417878830a31e32e78798fd8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/6594c979b4b4d7b071f1fc97d5614f4b914351b9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/13ee65355a4b68b16eaf628993ad4b23f98631fd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/d972c9c76171cb32d4aa925646d25e443cf9aca1.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/258dbb502341c5367cc1d4a96fdb414394eabec0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/03090563c615045f702900f7c597d69a794bbe6f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/f23d487487f2f77c1bfec03cbe3ccea618ad123e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36240325/53feb9ac0e9c41f8ee597b68b2a5704df3c93e13.png[/img][/url]

Let's get the bad news out of the way. I made some updates to the combat system. These updates are awesome and they fulfill the game's creative vision. However, any saves made prior to March 1st will now cause the game to crash. If you have gotten very far in the game and wish to continue with your stats and items, let me know. 

I am happy to make a custom save file for each and everyone with whatever they want if they purchased the game before March 1st. I'll do this despite the continued warnings in the game's description saying that the game is still in Beta.

May I offer an alternative to requesting the save file? I'm adding new content to the game every week. Perhaps you may want to start fresh and try the game again? It also will not hurt to wait for additional updates. 

More bad news: I had to temporarily remove achievements as they were causing crashes and menu errors. Don't worry, I intend to add achievements back into the game as soon as possible. Depending on what works, this could be fast (but it could also take a long time). Even though the game description states that achievements are currently a feature of the game, [b]achievements are not currently a feature of the game.[/b]

[h2]Familia Updates, 3/8/20[/h2][list][h3]Combat[/h3][*]Over 80 abilities were either refined or implemented
[*]Most enemies are now animated
[*]Combat UI has been highly customized, including cropped portrait displays
[*]Switch to Standard Timed Battle System, from Active Timed Battle System
[*]Turn order display added (icons are a WIP)
[*]Targeting cursors have been added to the UI
